'''Tyto''', designated '''CT-52/89-9204''', was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="Guide" />&mdash;a 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]&ndash;tall [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> with [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin<ref name="Skin" />&mdash;created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for service in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tyto served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] in command of [[Bacta Company]], a force of four [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] made up of a total of one hundred forty-four [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Bacta Company was part of the [[Hawkbat Battalion]] in the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]], which was, in turn, part of the [[7th Legion]] in the [[101st Regiment]] of the [[Systems Army Alpha]]'s [[Second Army|2nd Sector Army]].<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyto was first mentioned in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Guide" /> on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref>
